# RAZ Download Manager

> RAZ Download Manager (MDM) is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) download manager for Windows 10 and 11, with builds for Linux and macOS (today's marked experimental; Linux is no longer experimental from version 0.5.0, macOS still is). It is laid out like Internet Download Manager (IDM) — toolbar, categories, download list, progress window with every connection, queues and scheduler — and is not affiliated with Tonec Inc. In its published benchmark against IDM 6.42 on the same computer and server it was faster in all seven scenarios (5.4× on a 1 GiB file, 106× on a 256 KiB file).

Key facts:
- Price: free, no ads, no trial, no paid edition. Licence: GNU GPL 3.0. Source: https://github.com/razcreativestudio/razdownloadmanager
- Official Website: https://dm.it-raz.com/
- Downloads: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS (explicit and implicit TLS), BitTorrent and magnet links, and videos from web pages via yt-dlp. Proxies, SOCKS and PAC scripts.
- Engine: up to 64 connections per file (8 by default; 128 once allowed in Options), dynamic re-splitting, crash-safe resume, checksum verification, refresh of expired download links, per-server connection limits learned automatically.
- Browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi (.crx) and Firefox (.xpi): hands downloads over with cookies and referrer, right-click "Download with RAZ Download Manager", a draggable "Download video" button over videos. Without the extension, copying a link to a file opens the download window.
- 86 interface languages (every Windows 11 display language), right-to-left layouts for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur.
- Imports IDM's export files (.ef2). Accepts IDM's command-line switches (/d /p /f /a /n /s). Has a CLI (razdownloadmanager-cli, with --json output for scripts and agents) and a local token-protected automation API, described by a JSON Schema.
- AI assistants: an MCP server (razdownloadmanager-mcp) lets Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients list, add, pause, resume and remove downloads in the running app.
- Privacy: the app has no accounts, no analytics, no telemetry; an update check against GitHub at each start (and once a day while it runs) that can be turned off.
- Written in native Rust. Maintained by RAZ Creative Studio & open-source contributors.

## Pages

- [Download](https://dm.it-raz.com/download.html): Windows installer and portable zip, macOS .dmg, Linux AppImage/.deb/.rpm/.tar.gz, browser extension, checksums
- [Free IDM alternative](https://dm.it-raz.com/idm-alternative.html): RAZ Download Manager as a free, open-source alternative to Internet Download Manager, compared side by side with IDM and with nine other free download managers
- [Benchmark report with raw data](https://dm.it-raz.com/benchmark.html): 5.4x faster than IDM on 1 GiB file
- [Help and tutorials](https://dm.it-raz.com/help.html): Complete user guides, step-by-step tutorials, shortcuts, and troubleshooting
- [Questions and answers (FAQ)](https://dm.it-raz.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions
- [Privacy policy](https://dm.it-raz.com/privacy.html): Zero telemetry and local storage details
- [Terms of use](https://dm.it-raz.com/terms.html): Terms and conditions
- [Security](https://dm.it-raz.com/security.html): Private vulnerability reporting and release verification
- [License](https://dm.it-raz.com/license.html): GNU GPL v3.0 and third-party attributions
